newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $107/dressed - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $107/dressed - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Tuesday were trading in moderate activity at $106.00-$107.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, down $1.00 from Monday, according to market sources.
About 12,000-15,000 head had sold, with volume seen expanding as momentum continues to build, they said.
Early trading included cattle sold on a live basis at $65.00 to $66.00, down $1.00 from light sales on Friday.
Sluggish beef demand and expanded showlists this week fueled the weakness in feedlot cattle prices, market sources said.
